typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Control Status} as string,
		{Risk Instance Name 2} as string,
		{Design Target State} as string,
		Issue as integer,
		Modified as string,
		{Risk Instance Name 1} as string,
		{Year Issue Identified} as string,
		{SHRP Rating} as string,
		{Current Automation Status} as string,
		{Proposed Control Owner} as string,
		Control as string,
		{Proposed Process Owner} as string,
		{Issue Identifier} as string,
		{Automation Target Implementation Date} as string,
		{Control Owner} as string,
		{Automation Notes} as string,
		Procedure as string,
		{SHRP Control Description} as string,
		{SHRP Inactive Date} as string,
		{SHRP Control Name} as string,
		CA as string,
		Notes as string,
		Priority as string,
		TOD as string,
		{QA QC Indicator} as string,
		{Risk 1 Residual Rating} as string,
		TOP as string,
		BAU as string,
		{Metric Notes} as string,
		{Risk 1 Inherent Rating} as string,
		{Control ID} as string,
		{Target Implementation Date} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		ControlStatus as string,
		RiskInstanceName2 as string,
		DesignTargetState as string,
		Issue as integer,
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RiskInstanceName1 as string,
		YearIssueIdentified as string,
		SHRPRating as string,
		CurrentAutomationStatus as string,
		ProposedControlOwner as string,
		Control as string,
		ProposedProcessOwner as string,
		IssueIdentifier as string,
		AutomationTargetImplementationDate as string,
		ControlOwner as string,
		AutomationNotes as string,
		Procedure as string,
		SHRPControlDescription as string,
		SHRPInactiveDate as string,
		SHRPControlName as string,
		CA as string,
		Notes as string,
		Priority as string,
		TOD as string,
		QAQCIndicator as string,
		Risk1ResidualRating as string,
		TOP as string,
		BAU as string,
		MetricNotes as string,
		Risk1InherentRating as string,
		ControlID as string,
		TargetImplementationDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ControlStatus = {Control Status},
		RiskInstanceName2 = {Risk Instance Name 2},
		DesignTargetState = {Design Target State},
		Issue,
		Modified,
		RiskInstanceName1 = {Risk Instance Name 1},
		YearIssueIdentified = {Year Issue Identified},
		SHRPRating = {SHRP Rating},
		CurrentAutomationStatus = {Current Automation Status},
		ProposedControlOwner = {Proposed Control Owner},
		Control,
		ProposedProcessOwner = {Proposed Process Owner},
		IssueIdentifier = {Issue Identifier},
		AutomationTargetImplementationDate = {Automation Target Implementation Date},
		ControlOwner = {Control Owner},
		AutomationNotes = {Automation Notes},
		Procedure,
		SHRPControlDescription = {SHRP Control Description},
		SHRPInactiveDate = {SHRP Inactive Date},
		SHRPControlName = {SHRP Control Name},
		CA,
		Notes,
		Priority,
		TOD,
		QAQCIndicator = {QA QC Indicator},
		Risk1ResidualRating = {Risk 1 Residual Rating},
		TOP,
		BAU,
		MetricNotes = {Metric Notes},
		Risk1InherentRating = {Risk 1 Inherent Rating},
		ControlID = {Control ID},
		TargetImplementationDate = {Target Implementation Date}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
